question: Should this fix intentionally invalidate the Codex, Claude, Vertex AI, and pi-session cost caches to eliminate predecessor offsets that may have skipped incomplete tails?
rationale: The rebuild is technically justified by the changed offset contract, but maintainers must accept the upgrade-time full-rescan cost across all affected providers.

options.title: Accept one-time rebuild
options.body: Merge after proof and required checks confirm each affected cache rebuilds correctly and subsequent scans resume incrementally.

options.title: Narrow the invalidation
options.body: Require evidence that any unaffected cache family can safely retain predecessor offsets before reducing the version bumps.

recommendation.title: Accept one-time rebuild
recommendation.body: Merge after proof and required checks confirm each affected cache rebuilds correctly and subsequent scans resume incrementally.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and a person explicitly routed into this PR, `steipete` is the best available owner for the cross-provider upgrade tradeoff.
